items.title: Mistral raises €3B to bet big on sovereign AI
items.summary: Mistral’s co-founder and CEO Arthur Mensch STEPHANE DE SAKUTIN/Getty Images France’s Mistral has closed Europe’s largest-ever VC round, per PitchBook data, at €3 billion (around $3.5 billion) to fund its shift from a model lab to a full-stack enterprise AI provider. The Series D gives Mistral a post-money valuation of over €21 billion, up from €11.7 billion a year ago.
